The catchment area for the reservoir of a hydro-electric power plant is $1 4 \times 1 0 ^ { 8 }$ sq.m having an average rainfall per year of 125 cm, 70% of the rainfall is available for power generation and the mean operating head is 40 m. Calculate the maximum plant capacity to be installed.
Assume that 5% of the head is lost in penstock, turbine efficiency 85%, generator efficiency 90% and annual load factor is 45%.
